prompt:
Edit paint_mask_guide.png (input 1) exactly per this production brief. Input 2 design_reference.png is material/detail reference; input 3 icon_x8.png is color reference (magenta is background only).
Output ONE transparent PNG, 1536x2048 or nearest 3:4 canvas. Preserve the guide's exact three-column FOUR-row layout, with each object in exactly the same position, size, outline and orientation. Paint only existing grey pixels; never redraw, enlarge, move or redesign the silhouettes. The unusual edge-on views are intentional: row 1 has two short curved edge views and one long thin horizontal edge view; row 2 has a long thin horizontal edge at left, an upright full shield at center, empty at right. Rows 3-4 repeat these precise silhouettes.
Rows 1-2 PAINT: unlit base colour of narrow upright silver Ronenguard shield, symmetrical raised mask-and-sword relief from reference scaled into the upright view. All thin edge-on views stay thin and follow their grey guides. Facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls follow reference. Silver weathered metal base colors with fine material detail; no lighting, cast shadows, ambient occlusion, hot highlights/reflections. No invented straps or hardware.
Rows 3-4 MATERIAL MASK: same five silhouettes filled with FLAT pure colours only, no shading, texture, outlines or antialiased color blends inside. Pure red #FF0000 every metal part; pure green #00FF00 leather/fur; pure yellow #FFFF00 matte non-metal solid; pure black #000000 gemstone/glass/enamel/liquid. This all-metal shield uses solid pure red silhouettes throughout the mask rows, no face/sword details visible in those red fills. Every silhouette pixel exactly one material colour, nothing outside.
All gaps/openings remain transparent exactly as guide. Empty cells column 3 row 2 and row 4 remain completely transparent. No ground, text, outlines, halo, glow, sparkles or aura. Geometry/layout preservation takes absolute priority.
